label: NOTE: what this set reaches
why: V92Transmitter::process was read from .text+0x54590-0x546f2 in one sitting, so a green t_v92btosproc says our reading and the object agree and not that either is right. Every entry here is a claim that reading makes: which pointer the input byte lands in and at what index, that K is a THRESHOLD rather than a block size and is subtracted rather than cleared, that the precoder runs three times over four symbols each, that the convolution encoder's output is what the precoder gets NEXT time round, and that the twelve samples are scaled and truncated into the caller's buffer at the running count. WHAT NO ENTRY HERE REACHES: the mask that is not there. The object stores the caller's byte whole, and `V92ModulusEncoder::progress` reads it as `bytes[i] & 1`, so adding `& 1` at the store is unobservable through anything written and is left out rather than registered as equivalent -- see v92btosproc.json's note for the shape.
